info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Medicals-v1-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Medical Overview API provides users with comprehensive information regarding the medical records of pets available for adoption. This endpoint enables consumers to retrieve essential health details, vaccination statuses, and medical histories for each pet. Typically utilized by adoption agencies and potential pet adopters, this API aids in making informed decisions about pet adoption. By accessing this data, users ensure that they are well-informed about the medical needs of their future companions.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the medical records and health information for their pets. Users can access details such as vaccinations, treatments, and health histories for each pet, ensuring they stay informed about their pet's well-being.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve medical information related to pets. It should contain the necessary details to specify the medical data being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved medical records for pets.
